note_en: 一边……，一边…… describes two actions happening at the same time: 一边讲解，一边指出每个房间的位置 "explaining as I pointed out where each room would go." English usually makes one action the main verb and tucks the other into "while" or an -ing phrase, but Chinese gives both actions equal weight by putting 一边 in front of each one. Both actions must be done by the same person.
